info.title: Distru Public API - Shared Components
info.description: Shared schemas, parameters, and responses for Distru Public API v1. Phase 0.5 audited 2026-05-21 against live API. Canonical reference: /Users/budtags/Desktop/budtags/DISTRU-INTEGRATION-MAPPING.md.

PageSize.name: page[size]
PageSize.description: Records per page. SILENTLY IGNORED on most endpoints (per-endpoint hardcoded caps: 500/1k/5k/50k). Treat as hint, not contract.

UpdatedDatetime.name: updated_datetime
UpdatedDatetime.description: Comma-range string. Format: 'from,to' where each side is an ISO 8601 datetime. Either side may be empty for open-ended ranges (e.g. '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z,'). NOTE: this single comma-range param REPLACES the _from/_to pair pattern seen on other APIs.

InsertedDatetime.name: inserted_datetime
InsertedDatetime.description: Comma-range string. Same format as updated_datetime.

next_page.description: FULL URL STRING (not page number) of next page. Null or absent on final page. Follow blindly via subsequent GET; do not parse/reconstruct. Distru bakes the original query params (filters, page[size]) into this URL.

Location.description: Distru's Location is a single concatenated address string, NOT a structured object. There are no line_1/city/state/postal_code fields.

address.description: Single concatenated string like '123 Main St, Springfield, IL 62701'

CustomDataRead.description: Custom-field VALUES on entity GET responses. Shape: [{id: <int>, name: <string>, type: <string>, value: <any>}]

CustomDataWrite.description: Custom-field VALUES sent on POST. Shape: [{id, value}] — omit name and type (server-derived, read-only). Non-symmetric with read shape.

Charge.description: Inline charge (or discount) on order/invoice/purchase. Decision #13 in mapping doc.

Error.description: Error response. HTTP 400 typically returns {errors: {field: [messages]}}. HTTP 422 used uniquely on /file-attachments quota exceeded.

Forbidden.description: HTTP 403 — API key lacks RBAC permission. See categories/system.md for permissions matrix.

NotFound.description: HTTP 404 — resource id doesn't exist OR slug is wrong (e.g. /stock_adjustments returns 404; use /adjustments)

UnprocessableEntity.description: HTTP 422 — used on /file-attachments when tenant storage quota is exceeded

RateLimited.description: HTTP 429 — rate limit (no Retry-After header documented)
